notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Hello friends,

I just wanted to give a brief update on the things that are happening currently and what will happen in the near future.

First of all, thanks to everyone who is playing the game - I hope you enjoy it! Your support means a lot to a solo developer. Feel free to share all of your feedback, ideas, and wishes either in the Steam Community or on the official Discord. Here is the link to it: [url=https://discord.com/invite/fx4Jp8m8QD]LINK TO DISCORD SERVER[/url]

Regarding the work happening behind the scenes, I am working on releasing an update that will enable Steam Workshop. This means you will be able to share your cool level creations with others. Additionally, I am planning to bring some improvements to the In-Game Level Editor, which will include more objects to populate your levels. There will also be enhancements for placing important objects in your levels and providing appropriate pop-ups to ensure you have everything you need to play the level properly. Full localization of the In-Game Level Editor is also planned. I may also include some additional pre-placed objects in the default level, allowing you to focus purely on unleashing your imagination and going wild!

As you can see, the focus for the next update will mainly be on the In-Game Level Editor. However, I also have plans for additional game modes with different playstyles in the near future. Depending on player interest, I might expand the current game modes with additional content as well.

Thank you, and keep rolling!

notes.title: In-Game Level Editor is Live!
notes.content:
Hello friends,

As promised in the last news update on the 18th of May, the In-Game Level Editor is now live! It took me a while to release this, and it is still not perfect, but I do plan to update and improve it further down the road.

[previewyoutube=8CjXSX3W8Jw;full][/previewyoutube]

You should be able to create your own levels with the latest update, which you can download right now on Steam! It still does not have proper Steam Workshop integration; however, you can copy the level, which is usually located in "Steam/steamapps/common/Roll the Ball/RollBall_PC/CustomLevels/NAMEOFYOURLEVEL," and share it with other people. You can then easily paste the level in the same location on another PC and run it!

In the future, besides general updates and polishing of this feature, it will be getting things like full localization, gamepad support, proper Steam Workshop integration, and many more presets like meshes, effects, traps, and potentially some pre-made levels. This way, you can directly look at some examples and adjust them to your needs.

Also, feel free to join the Discord channel, where you can share your levels, post images, and ask any questions you might have. Here is the link: [url=https://discord.gg/fx4Jp8m8QD]JOIN DISCORD[/url]

Feel free to let me know if you have any issues or feedback that could improve the game, and I will gladly consider it.

Thank you and keep rolling!

notes.title: In-Game Level Editor
notes.content:
Hello friends,

I am really glad to announce that Roll the Ball will be getting the [b]In-Game Level Editor[/b] in the upcoming week or two! You will be able to create your own levels and go really crazy with your imagination. I will not reveal the number of placeables you will be able to use at this stage, but it will definitely be in the hundreds! Rocks, foliage, structures, traps, props, effects, music, and more will be available for you to use in your own levels!

You will also be able to share these levels with other people and let them enjoy your cool creations as well! I expect that this feature will come in a polished stage once it is released, but it will definitely receive updates in the future. Below, you can find a quick video of me creating one level in the tropical biome. No worries, you will be able to create levels in snow, greenland, and also interior ones!

Let me know if you have any questions or any potential suggestions that you might want to have in the [b]upcoming In-Game Level Editor![/b]
[previewyoutube=8CjXSX3W8Jw;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you and keep rolling!

notes.title: Free Camera Mode!
notes.content:
Hello friends,

I am excited to announce that Roll the Ball has just received the Free Camera Mode update! By default, the camera is locked; however, if you get the latest update, you will be able to activate the free camera mode! This feature was requested by some players, and I am really glad that it has become part of the game!

Here is the full list of changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Added free camera control - you can switch between fixed camera and free camera by hitting 'E' on your keyboard or 'X' on the controller. It works in every game mode except the Prelude level.
[*] Added an option to reset the fail counter without losing skins, trophies, etc. - it is accessible in the level select menu for each game mode.
[*] Added two new options in the options menu - mouse sensitivity and invert mouse control.
[*] Various optimizations in the Speed Run level.
[*] Centered UIs and set the unified scale for the menu titles.
[*] Fixed distant water having strong black shadow.
[*] Fixed eyes being visible and the ball not when losing the level.
[*] Improved the look of the water.
[*] Many visual issues fixed.
[*] Improved visuals by adding meshes and foliage in some of the levels.
[*] Removed two storylines from the Prelude level.
[*] Localization updates.
[*] Improved fade objects near the camera because of the new free camera control mode.
[*] Added a new pop-up about the free camera mode.
[*] Fixed wrong custom depth in Level 14 Hard, which caused unwanted objects to have different visuals.
[/list]

Feel free to let me know if you have any issues or feedback that could improve the game, and I will gladly consider it.

Thank you and keep rolling!

notes.title: Roll the Ball fully supports Xbox Controller
notes.content:
Hello friends,

I have some great news for those who were asking for controller support. [b]Roll the Ball now fully supports the Xbox Controller![/b] I hope you will enjoy this update and feel free to let me know if you have any other feedback that could improve the game. The list of planned updates that was provided upon Roll the Ball's release continues to be worked on, and the game will be updated in the months to come.

List of changes implemented in the latest build update:

[list]
[*] Added gamepad support
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing P or ESC to pause the game would sometimes do nothing; instead, the player had to press it two times
[*] Fixed an issue where pressing P or ESC to pause the game on the win screen would unpause the game and cause the player to lose
[*] Fixed an issue where activating Steam Overlay while being on the win screen would unpause the game and cause the player to lose
[*] Fixed a couple of areas where the ball could get stuck in the Prelude level; more fixes will follow shortly
[*] Some other minor visual updates and fixes
[/list]

notes.content:

notes.title: Roll the Ball is released!
notes.content:
Roll the Ball has just been released and is available for purchase with 10% discount for the first 7 days! On this occasion, I have prepared a new video that you can watch. I cannot describe the feeling of releasing my first game, but I am definitely very proud, excited, and a little nervous about what the future holds. Working on creating and releasing Roll the Ball has been a huge experience and will definitely help me in creating my own future video games. It wasn't easy, even though Roll the Ball may look like a simple game, I did my best to provide a pleasant gameplay and a smooth experience. Thank you once again to everyone for your support, and see you in the near future. Roll the Ball will surely receive new content and I can already foreshadow some of the initial plans below, these are both short term and long term plans:
[list]
[*] Additional Time Rush levels, together with new biomes and traps.
[*] Additional Challenge levels, together with new biomes and traps.
[*] One additional Speed Run level, or additional game mode where you have multiple shorter Speed Run Levels.
[*] Online leaderboard for Time Rush and Speed Run levels.
[*] Level editor.
[*] Additional skins.
[*] Full gamepad support.
[/list]
Besides short term and long term updates, there will be constant updated and patches which will fix and/or improve any outstanding problems. If you encounter any issue, feel free to reach directly to me via email, or make a post in the Steam community hub. Also, if you have any suggestions, or feedback, feel free to let me know!
Take care and stay healthy, we will speak again soon!
[previewyoutube=2HeEb52VEhY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Latest Development Update
notes.content:
[b]Dear friends,[/b]

Here comes the new update! Lately, I have been working hard to finalize the Speed Run level, and so far, you can reach almost 600 meters! I dare to say that this might be really hard to complete and that it will take a couple of hours to reach the top once it is finished. All Time Rush mode levels, together with bonus levels, are completed, and the same goes for the Challenge mode.

Besides this, I have also been working on updating the game visually. Primarily, by adding quite a lot more trees and foliage, which will make the scenery really interesting, and also by adding back the cel shader look. You can check the image below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711611/4d182f9a65206bad039f98f52db06f663ca338c3.jpg[/img]
Also, I wanted to make Time Rush levels have a little bit more flavor to them, so you will be able to meet the boy every few levels, where you will discover a bit more of the backstory. You can check the image below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44711611/cc6d261a822d62474a1284d2b1a20e2a68aa5008.png[/img]
Don't forget to wishlist the game, and see you rolling very soon!

Developer of Roll the Ball

notes.title: Development update and localization news
notes.content:
[b]Dear friends,[/b]

I hope you are doing well! I wanted to share a quick update on Roll the Ball. Overall, the development is progressing smoothly, and the game is entering its final stage. I can already anticipate that the game will be released either at the end of February or the beginning of March. I want to take an extra few weeks to ensure that you have the best possible experience!

Additionally, I'm pleased to announce that the game will be localized in multiple languages, including English, Bosnian, German, French, Spanish, Turkish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Korean! If you have any additional language preferences, feel free to let me know!

In the coming days, I will be providing more frequent updates.

Don't forget to wishlist the game, and see you rolling very soon!

Developer of Roll the Ball
